items.question: Can the agent hand off complex calls to my team?
items.answer: Yes. You define the handoff rules, and the agent transfers the conversation with full context whenever a request falls outside its scope.

items.question: Which channels does the agent cover?
items.answer: Voice calls, SMS, web chat, WhatsApp, and email - one agent keeps the same context across all of them.

items.question: How long does setup take?
items.answer: A working agent takes minutes to launch from a template. Connecting your scheduling tools is guided and typically done the same day.
